rows.label: false reject (a known gate limit)
rows.why: Strict removed-free rule (D-0046): the fix drops zip_source_free(src_window) and the PoC then reports a leak under LSan, but the leak is allocated in _zip_read_cdir/_zip_string_new (lib/zip_open.c:305), not src_window: a pre-existing leak the original use-after-free used to mask. Kept strict for model candidates.
